title: Trunk-or-treat Saturday, pumpkin racers Sunday
intro: Halloween warm-up weekend. Saturday: RPV's trunk-or-treat and ICAN's inclusive Halloween fest in the morning, then Sea Scare at Cabrillo at night. Sunday: free puppets in Los Feliz or homemade pumpkin racers down MB Blvd. Torrance Unified has no school Friday, Oct 16 — Friday Fun at Madrona Marsh or a free-to-enter pumpkin patch on Prairie are easy wins. We left parking, food, and prices blank unless an official page confirmed them.

picks.name: Mr. Jack O' Lanterns Pumpkin Patch – Torrance
picks.when: Open daily through November 1 — an easy pick for Friday, October 16 (no school for Torrance Unified). Hours are not posted on the official site; call (844) 452-2567 ext. 1.
picks.address: 17520 Prairie Ave (1 block south of Artesia Blvd; enter northbound on Prairie)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: admission is free and parking is free (official FAQ and locations page) → $0 to walk in. Pumpkins are priced by size. The Jack O' Pass (unlimited games, one mini pumpkin, one pumpkin-decorating session) is extra; price not listed online.
picks.parking: Free on-site lot (official). Enter going northbound on Prairie Ave.
picks.food: Food and drinks for purchase; offerings vary by location (official FAQ).
picks.why: Free-to-enter patch with a petting zoo, bounce house, pumpkin bowling, and pumpkin smash — easy no-school Friday close to home.

picks.name: RPV Trunk or Treat
picks.address: Ken Dyda Civic Center, 30940 Hawthorne Blvd
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: no admission price on the city flyer (treat as free). Trunk-or-treating, inflatables, face painting, games, giveaways, puppet show, music, costume parade. Food vendors paid.
picks.parking: Civic Center parking plus additional free parking and a shuttle from Point Vicente Interpretive Center, 31501 Palos Verdes Dr. West (official flyer).
picks.food: Food vendors on site (official flyer). Prices not listed.
picks.why: City trunk-or-treat with inflatables, a puppet show, and a costume parade — an easy daytime Halloween.

picks.name: ICAN Inclusive Halloween Festival
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free to attend (official). Food and merch for purchase. Registration link on the official page. Built for people with disabilities of all ages; families and caregivers encouraged.
picks.parking: The official page does not list parking.
picks.food: Food for purchase on site (official). Prices not listed.
picks.why: Free, welcoming Halloween fest with a bubble show, magic shows, and a costume contest — built so every kid can join in.

picks.name: Sea Scare! Monsters of Myth
picks.when: Saturday, October 17, 7:00–10:00 p.m. (food trucks 5:00 p.m.; members early entry 6:00 p.m.; final entry 9:00 p.m.)
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: pre-sale non-members $18 + $18 + $12 + $12 = $60 entry. CMA says it will sell out — buy online. Event-night parking not priced on the Sea Scare page (daytime lot is $3/hr, $9 max, card only).
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot. Daytime rules: $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only. Event-night parking not listed separately.
picks.food: Food trucks from 5:00 p.m. (official). Prices not listed.
picks.why: One-night aquarium Halloween: trick-or-treat, family haunted house, DJ, costume contest. Buy tickets before Saturday.

picks.name: Puppets in the Park at Hollyhock House
picks.when: Sunday, October 18, shows 9:30–10:00 a.m. and 11:00–11:30 a.m. (gates 9:00 a.m.); family art activities 10–11 a.m. and 11:30 a.m.–12:30 p.m.
picks.address: Hollyhock House, Barnsdall Art Park, 4800 Hollywood Blvd
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free, no RSVP needed (official). Parking cost not listed on the event page.
picks.parking: The event page does not list parking.
picks.food: Not a food event. Bring a blanket (official).
picks.why: Free Bob Baker Hallowe'en Spooktacular puppet show on the lawn, plus art activities — about 40–50 minutes from Torrance.
picks.age_gate: All ages; lawn capacity is limited and pets aren't permitted

picks.name: Manhattan Beach World Famous Pumpkin Race
picks.when: Sunday, October 18, 12:00 p.m. festival (races start 2:00 p.m. sharp)
picks.address: Manhattan Beach Pier / Manhattan Beach Blvd
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free festival (official city page). Racing is optional: official kits $35 before the event, $40 day-of; optional $7 Turbo Pass covers two entries with timed access. Watching costs $0.
picks.parking: Pier parking lots and Manhattan Beach Blvd close for the event (city page). Plan to park farther out or use MB Wave Rider ($5 per person per ride via the Circuit app).
picks.food: Downtown Manhattan Beach restaurants. Festival food not listed on the city page.
picks.why: Homemade pumpkin racers flying down MB Blvd toward the pier — free to watch, $35 kit if your kids want to race.
picks.description: Free pumpkin race festival at the Manhattan Beach Pier; races at 2:00 p.m. Optional official racer kits $35 ($40 day-of).

picks.name: Torrance Halloween Movie in the Park
picks.when: Saturday, October 24, activities from 4:00 p.m.; Toy Story 5 starts 6:30 p.m.
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free community event (City of Torrance). Costume parade, kids zone, DJ, pumpkin-carving display before the movie. Food vendors paid.
picks.parking: Wilson Park lots. The official pages do not list a fee.
picks.food: Food vendors from the Torrance Certified Farmers Market (Discover Torrance). Prices not listed. Bring blankets and low-back chairs.
picks.why: Free costume parade and Toy Story 5 under the stars at Wilson Park — the easiest Halloween night out in Torrance.

picks.name: San Pedro Día de los Muertos Festival
picks.cost_math: Free, family-friendly festival (official). Food and vendor purchases extra. Downtown parking cost not listed on the event page.
picks.parking: The event page does not list parking. Expect downtown street and lot parking.
picks.food: Food vendors on site (official). Prices not listed.
picks.why: Altars, Aztec and folklórico dancers, and a Catrina contest — a big free cultural festival 20 minutes from Torrance.

picks.name: Riviera Village Halloween Trick or Treat
picks.when: Saturday, October 31, 3:00–8:00 p.m. (candy until 6:00 p.m. while supplies last)
picks.address: Riviera Village, Catalina Ave (Avenue I to S. Elena St)
picks.cost_math: Free street trick-or-treat. Cashless paid parking at Plaza Riviera (1611 S Catalina Ave) and the Mira Mar Park lot; rates not listed.
picks.parking: Triangle lot between Avenida Del Norte and S. Elena, street spots, cashless paid parking at Plaza Riviera (1611 S Catalina Ave), and a paid lot at Mira Mar Park (201 Paseo de la Playa). Rates not listed.
picks.food: Village restaurants; stay for dinner (official). No event food listed.
picks.why: Halloween afternoon on a car-free Catalina Ave — the South Bay's big street trick-or-treat. Go early; candy runs out at 6.

picks.name: Friday Fun at Madrona Marsh
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: Free. Pre-registration required by phone (310) 782-3989; opens Tuesday 10:00 a.m. the same week; first 20.
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. The official page does not list a fee.
picks.food: The official page does not list food.
picks.why: Preschool story, science, art, and a marsh tour — on the no-school Friday.

picks.name: Wilson Park Train Rides (Southern California Live Steamers)
picks.when: Saturday, October 17, 12:00–3:00 p.m. (public rides every third Saturday)
picks.cost_math: No fare listed for public rides (official club site). The club runs on donations at the station; $2 per rider is the suggested donation for birthday and group trains.
picks.parking: The official club site does not list parking.
picks.why: Volunteer-run miniature trains, 15–25 minutes a loop — a classic Torrance Saturday.
picks.age_gate: Riders must be 32" tall and walk on their own; no infants; kids ride with an adult

picks.name: The Point Kids Club: Halloween Trick-or-Treat
picks.address: The Point, 850 S. Pacific Coast Highway
picks.cost_math: No admission price on The Point's page (treat as free). Bring trick-or-treat bags; scan the check-in QR code on arrival.
picks.parking: The Point's lots. The event page does not list a fee.
picks.food: Shopping-center restaurants; a few one-day deals listed (official).
picks.why: Weekday-morning trick-or-treat for little ones with music, balloons, and strolling characters.
